description: A food expansion mod for Minecraft 1.12.2 Forge, created with MCreator by an independent creator from China. Adds fries, hamburgers and chicken nuggets. Licensed under GPL 3.0.

releases.notes:
## v1.1.2
### Changes / 更新内容
- Updated `mcmod.info` metadata to unify the mod display name
- 调整 `mcmod.info` 元数据，统一模组对外显示名称
- Corrected author information
- 修正作者署名信息
- Revised built-in mod description
- 完善模组内置介绍文本

### Important Note / 重要说明
This release contains **no new items, recipes, or gameplay changes**.
It is purely a metadata correction update.
本次更新**未新增任何物品、配方与游戏内容**，仅为模组元信息修复版本。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/EreadorAwalmc/MoreFastFood/compare/v1.1.1...v1.1.2

## V1.1.1 Update
- Added full Simplified Chinese & Traditional Chinese localization for Cheese, Shredded Cheese, Raw Pizza and Pizza.
- Minor internal code and asset adjustment.

## V1.1.1 更新
- 为奶酪、芝士碎、生披萨、披萨添加简体中文、繁体中文完整译名
- 少量内部代码与资源微调

## V1.1.0 Update
- Added complete pizza production chain: Raw Pizza → Furnace-cooked Pizza
- Added Cheese (raw crafting material, non-edible)
- Added Shredded Cheese
- Rebalanced food hunger & saturation statistics
- Pizza grants potion effects upon consumption
- Tuned item stack sizes for gameplay balance

⚠️ Notice
Cheese, Shredded Cheese, Raw Pizza and Pizza only have English names in this build.
Full Chinese localization for these new items will be added in V1.1.1.

## V1.1.0 更新
- 新增完整披萨合成链：生披萨 → 熔炉烧制披萨
- 新增奶酪（原材料，不可直接食用）
- 新增芝士碎
- 重新平衡各类食物饥饿值与饱和度
- 食用披萨将获得药水增益效果
- 调整物品堆叠上限优化游戏平衡

⚠️ 提示
奶酪、芝士碎、生披萨、披萨在当前版本仅拥有英文名称，完整中文汉化将在 V1.1.1 加入。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/EreadorAwalmc/MoreFastFood/compare/v1.0.0-r1...v1.1.0

# MoreFastFood v1.0.0-r1 Release
## 【中文】
V1.0.0-r1 小幅修复修订版，基于 v1.0.0 进行细节问题修正
支持 Minecraft 1.12.2 Forge

### 包含物品
- 生汉堡 Raw Hamburger
- 汉堡 Hamburger
- 生鸡块 Raw Chicken Nugget
- 鸡块 Chicken Nugget
- 薯条 French Fries

### 模组机制
食用生食将会施加负面效果。

### 更新内容
小幅Bug修复与细节微调，物品、核心游戏机制无改动。

### 开源声明
MCreator完整工程源码托管在此仓库，项目遵循 **CC-BY-SA 4.0** 协议开源。

## 【English】
v1.0.0-r1 minor patch. Minor fixes on the basis of v1.0.0
For Minecraft 1.12.2 Forge

### Items
- Raw Hamburger
- Hamburger
- Raw Chicken Nugget
- Chicken Nugget
- French Fries

### Mechanics
Consuming raw food will apply negative status effects.

### Changes
Minor bug fixes and fine adjustments. No changes to items and core gameplay.

### Open Source
Full MCreator workspace source code is available in this repository, licensed under **CC-BY-SA 4.0**.
